summary: Phase 3 adequacy gate FINAL verdict: GATE FAIL after 3 bounded dispatches (dispatch 3 explicitly user-authorized beyond the plan's 2-dispatch cap; no dispatch 4 will be opened). Lemma 6.2.2 (hard direction) remains complete/sorry-free/axiom-clean (reused unchanged). Lemma 6.1.2/6.2.3 (tree internalization) is NOT closed. Dispatch 3 wrote no new Lean code -- it re-derived the tree-telescope formula directly against the source PDF (Figure 6-1/6-2, the worked example) and found two further genuine corrections beyond dispatch 2's scaffold: (1) Simpson's T^i (i<m) must EXCLUDE the path-continuation child (a 'pruned' subtree), whereas the scaffold's LTree.pathTo returns the full unpruned subtree -- confirmed wrong by direct recomputation of the worked example; (2) the scaffold's Star_append lemma does not correspond to what boxI/diaI/diaE actually need from LTree.addChild/pathToList (an unproven commutation lemma). Dispatch 3 also resolved (clarified, not mechanized) dispatch 2's diaE z-scoping concern: threading an explicit companion LTree witness through the induction guarantees x and z are always nodes of one tree with a well-defined LCA, exactly what Simpson's Figure 6-2 argument assumes -- this raises confidence the theorem is TRUE, but the remaining mechanization is larger than previously estimated (revised: 2-3 further dispatches, not 1-2). Phase 9 (assembly of cs5_completeness) is confirmed unreachable without this bridge. Task returns to [BLOCKED]. Phases 1, 2, 4 remain landed, sorry-free, axiom-clean, CI-green; Phases 5-8 were not attempted (out of this gate's scope) and remain independently dispatchable in a future task regardless of Phase 3's fate.

sorry_inventory.note: Zero sorry, zero new axiom under Cslib/. Nothing was landed or modified under Cslib/ this dispatch. probes/lemma612-scaffold.lean and probes/adequacy-gate-probe.lean remain sorry-free and axiom-clean (unchanged from dispatch 2/1 respectively).

See specs/517_.../handoffs/lemma612-final-blocker-dispatch3.md for the full diagnosis and an updated 8-step recipe for any future attempt.
